summary:
Senior Backend Engineer with 10+ years of experience building scalable eCommerce and SaaS platforms. Expertise in
PHP, Laravel, Symfony, REST APIs, and MySQL optimization, with a strong focus on performance tuning and system
reliability.
Proven track record of designing high-performance backend systems, leading development teams, and implementing
CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless and stable deployments.
Recently focused on AI-assisted development, building and integrating AI-powered solutions to automate debugging,
optimize backend workflows, and improve development productivity.
Passionate about developing secure, scalable, and efficient systems while leveraging modern technologies, including
DevOps, automation, and AI-driven engineering practices.

jobs.role: PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE (10+ YEARS) Senior PHP Developer / Technical Lead
jobs.company: Basis Vectors Portfolio Services India Pvt. Ltd. (CommerceV3
bullets: Leading backend development for a multi-tenant eCommerce SaaS platform supporting multiple merchants and high-volume transactions
Designing and implementing secure RESTful APIs for products, checkout, orders, promotions, and third-party integrations.
Developing and maintaining payment gateway integrations including Authorize.Net and Razorpay.
Conducting code reviews and enforcing coding standards to maintain clean, maintainable architecture.
Managing CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Git-based workflows to ensure stable and repeatable deployments.
Monitoring production systems, analyzing logs, and resolving live issues to maintain application stability.
Implementing caching strategies and optimizing database queries to improve API and page response times.
Refactoring critical backend modules to enhance checkout reliability and reduce cart-related failures.
Designing and maintaining multi-tenant features including pricing rules, logistics integrations, and tax services.
Collaborating closely with product, QA, and frontend teams to deliver scalable and reliable releases.
Mentoring junior developers and guiding them on Laravel best practices, debugging strategies, and code quality improvements. AI & Automation Contributions:
Developed an AI-based log analysis tool using PHP and OpenAI API to automatically detect errors and suggest fixes
Designed end-to-end flow: log input → API request → AI-based root cause analysis → fix recommendation
Integrated AI API using cURL to process application logs and return structured debugging insights
Reduced manual debugging effort by automating log analysis and improving issue resolution speed
Built reusable backend utility to assist developers in identifying production issues efficiently
Applied prompt engineering techniques to improve accuracy of AI-generated responses
Designed and developed LMS modules using Laravel & Yii and ReactJS, aligned with enterprise training workflows.
Built and maintained RESTful APIs for integrations with third-party HR and analytics platforms.
Refactored existing modules to improve code structure, maintainability, and overall application performance.
Optimized database queries and reduced unnecessary API calls to improve system responsiveness.
Collaborated closely with UI/UX and frontend teams to enhance usability and cross-device compatibility.
Participated in code reviews and implemented structured development practices to improve release quality.
Contributed to automated regression testing to minimize recurring production issues.
Developed and optimized large-scale eCommerce and content applications using Laravel.
Implemented indexing and caching strategies to improve SQL query performance and overall application responsiveness.
Refined user signup flow and referral features to improve onboarding experience and system usability.
Contributed to improving test coverage and strengthening release stability through structured testing practices.
Built and maintained core PHP modules for multiple eCommerce and CRM implementations with configurable dashboards.
Customized and deployed admin dashboards to support operational workflows and reporting requirements.
Integrated payment, shipping, and CRM APIs to streamline system processes and reduce manual operational effort.
Delivered multiple B2B eCommerce and ERP web applications using PHP and MySQL while following security and compliance standards.
Contributed to migrating legacy systems to modern PHP frameworks to improve maintainability and code structure.
Implemented secure authentication mechanisms and role-based access control (RBAC) for enterprise workflows.
Developed and launched company websites and CRM tools with responsive, cross-browser frontends and reliable backends.
Executed end-to-end frontend development and backend integration, ensuring compatibility across devices and browsers.
Followed structured release practices to maintain application stability after deployment.
